ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 is drafted conjunctively and limb (d) is not satisfied: the trip record for TRP-00705 records no cancellation at all. cancellation_reason_code, cancelled_at and cancelled_by are all null and the trip status is COMPLETED, so the driver never terminated the trip for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. On that limb alone no cancellation fee is chargeable to the rider, and the driver's own statement concedes no cancellation fee was collected.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails independently. The driver's 'arrived' event is timestamped 2026-09-22T12:12:40+08:00 - the same second as accepted_at - but the driver's trace only begins at 12:12:50 and the earliest qualifying in-geofence fix is also 12:12:50 (dwell_start_offset_sec = -10 s). The trace therefore contains no fix placing the driver inside the POL-NS-02 pickup geofence at or before the arrival event, which is precisely what limb (b) requires.

On the driver's own telemetry the in-geofence dwell is 50 seconds - the longest qualifying run is 6 fixes from 12:12:50 to 12:13:40, with a qualifying_fix_count of 6 - against a 300-second minimum for the STANDARD pickup zone class, a shortfall of 250 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable on that shortfall and refunds it to the rider in full, with no driver compensation payable, whether or not the rider was present.

The only route that could bridge the shortfall - accumulating separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06 limb (i) - is unavailable. It requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated with a qualifying type, and EV-ADVIS-00705-01 is MISSING: no payload, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0. I rely on the absence, not on any content; the absence is itself citable, and it means the 250-second shortfall stands and the driver cannot have his separate intervals summed.

Even disregarding the arrival marker, limb (c) of POL-NS-01 measures the continuous dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. That clock runs from 12:12:50 to 12:13:40 - 50 seconds against the 300-second minimum - so the fee fails limb (c) on the clause's own arithmetic, whatever the driver tapped and whenever he tapped it.

No part of the disputed SGD 9.40 is a lawful no-show charge. The ledger itemises the cancellation-fee line at 0.00 and computes a no-show schedule fee of only 4.00 for this trip's STANDARD zone class and RYDE_X tier; because none of POL-NS-01's four limbs is satisfied, not even that figure is chargeable. POL-NS-06 directs a full refund where the dwell falls short, and the rider should not be left carrying the disputed charge.

POL-NS-07 is no answer for the driver: its compensation is payable only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Here POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (b), (c) and (d), and POL-NS-06 displaces it on the shortfall, so no driver compensation arises at all and the rider funds nothing.

The rider's demand is aimed at a fee this trip never carried. EV-FARE-00705 records cancellation_fee SGD 0.00 and its own derived money block reports fee_charged '0.00' and driver_compensation '0.00'; the SGD 9.40 she contests is the completed-trip fare (quoted_fare_sgd 9.40, total_charged 9.40), not a no-show charge. POL-NS-01 is the only clause that makes a no-show fee chargeable, and nothing on this record was charged under it, so there is no fee line for the rider's demand to reach.

The trip was performed, not terminated for a no-show. EV-TRIP-00705 shows status COMPLETED with cancelled_at null, cancelled_by null and cancellation_reason_code null, and records a start at 12:13:40 and an end at 12:25:40 over 2.3 km. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the driver to have terminated the trip on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; that event never occurred, so the no-show mechanism was never engaged — and there is no termination of the kind the rider's claim presupposes.

The driver's own 10-second trace puts him at the pin, not merely near it. Against the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m set by POL-NS-02, EV-GPS-00705 records 6 consecutive qualifying fixes inside that radius from 12:12:50 to 12:13:40, a minimum distance to the pin of 1.13 m, 78 driver fixes, 100 percent coverage and zero gaps. The POL-NS-02 proximity test is satisfied on admissible fixes and the suggestion that the driver was not there fails.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged and no false-arrival referral is available. At the recorded arrival event (12:12:40) the trace places the driver within 1.13 m of the pin, far inside the clause's 300 m limit, and 0.0 kph appears among the distinct speeds in EV-GPS-00705, so he was stationary rather than travelling at the 15 kph threshold. The arrival marker was true, and the waiting clock it started is not disturbed.

The rider has no exonerating route under POL-NS-04 in any event. Limb (a) requires at least one locating or coordinating message from the rider during the waiting window, and EV-CHAT-00705 holds zero messages (message_count 0, first_message_at null), with EV-TRIP-00705 recording chat_message_count 0 and an empty in_app_calls list. Limb (c) cannot be run at all because EV-GPS-00705 carries no rider track (rider_presence available false, rider_fix_count 0), which that clause makes neutral rather than favourable. The clause therefore does not apply.

The driver does not dispute that his in-geofence run lasted 50 seconds, short of the 300-second STANDARD minimum, and he does not rest his case on limb (c) of POL-NS-01. That shortfall buys the rider nothing: the only remedy POL-NS-06 provides is a full refund of the cancellation-fee line, which EV-FARE-00705 itemises at SGD 0.00, and POL-NS-06(i) could not even be reached here because it needs a present and populated traffic_advisory — EV-ADVIS-00705-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, status MISSING), and no advisory covers this pickup road in this window. Disclosure: the driver relies on that artifact only as an absence, never against a payload.

The SGD 9.40 charged is exactly the fare the rider accepted. EV-FARE-00705 reports fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 9.40 and total_charged 9.40, itemised as base 3.80 + distance 2.45 + time 2.35 + platform fee 0.80 over the 2.3 km, 12.0 minute ride in EV-TRIP-00705, whose registered dropoff is the very waypoint the rider names in her own claim and whose deviation of -42.5 percent shows the route actually run was shorter than the routing optimum. There is no arithmetic excess anywhere in the ledger, and under POL-GEN-03 the present state — payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — stands.

The cash demand that underpins the rider's account is not in the record. EV-CHAT-00705 contains zero messages and EV-TRIP-00705 records chat_message_count 0 with no in-app calls, so no request for cash to wait is documented anywhere; the driver's statement of 2026-09-23 denies collecting anything beyond the platform-calculated fare; and the rider's own claim text concedes 'No separate cash waiting payment was made.' On POL-GEN-03's definition, the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the charge is left as it is.

Neither driver compensation nor escalation is available on this record, and the driver claims neither. POL-NS-07 computes compensation as 80 percent of the cancellation fee itemised in the ledger, and EV-FARE-00705 itemises that fee at SGD 0.00, so the figure is SGD 0.00 as the ledger's own derived block reports; the anti-farming check does not trip in any case (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 110, failing both the 4-or-more and the above-8-percent limbs). No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged either: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the abuse and repeat-party limbs read nothing; the deciding facts are carried by full-weight artifacts (EV-TRIP-00705, EV-GPS-00705 and EV-FARE-00705 are allCOMPLETE at weight 1.0) under POL-GEN-02.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the contested SGD 9.40 is not a no-show or cancellation charge. EV-FARE-00705 (weight 1.0, COMPLETE) records fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 9.40 and total_charged 9.40, itemised as base fare 3.80 + distance fare 2.45 + time fare 2.35 + platform fee 0.80, with the cancellation-fee line at 0.00 and payment_status CHARGED. EV-TRIP-00705 (weight 1.0, COMPLETE) shows status COMPLETED on a 2.3 km, 12.0-minute ride to the rider's registered home waypoint, with cancellation_reason_code, cancelled_at and cancelled_by all null. The no-show mechanism therefore never engaged and no cancellation fee was ever charged.

The rider is correct on the no-show arithmetic, and it decides nothing here. POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails because the trip was never terminated on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and the in-geofence dwell was only 50 seconds (6 qualifying fixes, 12:12:50 to 12:13:40) against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a 250-second shortfall under POL-NS-06. But those findings decide whether a cancellation fee is chargeable, and the cancellation-fee line is SGD 0.00 - POL-NS-06 refunds that line, and refunding zero is nothing. The rider's request is not for that line; it is for the completed-trip fare, and no no-show clause makes a delivered, correctly-priced ride refundable. POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00705-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); that absence does not change the outcome.

The driver is also correct that the compensation machinery pays out nothing: POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not, and 80 percent of a SGD 0.00 fee line is SGD 0.00. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 110). No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged - confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, no repeat-party counters read anything, and the deciding facts are carried by full-weight (1.0) artifacts under POL-GEN-02(2). No referral is produced by any clause: there are qualifying in-geofence fixes, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and no other referral clause applies.

The rider's cash-demand allegation is not supported by the record: EV-CHAT-00705 contains zero messages, EV-TRIP-00705 records chat_message_count 0 and no in-app calls, the driver's statement of 2026-09-23 denies collecting anything beyond the platform-calculated fare, and the rider herself concedes that no separate cash waiting payment was made. That allegation cannot be verified on this record, but it does not make the platform fare refundable.

Result: the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence, and the present state stands. The SGD 9.40 charge is left in place; no refund and no driver compensation issue.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
